lines: You will spend about seven years of your waking life scrolling.
The global average is two hours twenty one minutes a day.
Times three sixty five. Times fifty years. That is eighteen hundred days.
Why can't you stop? A book has chapters. A show has an ending. A feed has neither.
So you have to be the end.
Three rules. Decide before you open it. Give it an ending. Replace it, do not just remove it.
